in_marathi.name: Suresha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who brings success
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suresha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Suresha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Suresh', which means 'God of Wealth' or 'One who brings success'. This name is often given to a girl to bestow her with the blessings of prosperity and good fortune.
